nodes.summary: The adapter is a finite component of the existing Host. Its input counter has `n` physical symbols; the bound is linear in that length, not in the bit length of an arbitrary binary-encoded numeric input.

nodes.summary: The component retains the existing emitter's heterogeneous alphabets.

nodes.summary: The actual emitter halt is followed by charged scratch cleanup.

nodes.summary: The finite label enumeration uses the existing emitter enumeration and two Boolean choices, without a noncomputable list conversion.
nodes.title: Label enumeration of the unary-to-binary converter

nodes.summary: Existing emitter labels and the cleanup/unframing continuation.
nodes.title: Control labels of the unary-to-binary converter

nodes.summary: `framed = true` keeps the new frame; otherwise only that frame is removed, preserving any earlier output below it.

nodes.summary: Emit one canonical Nat frame above any earlier output and restore all conversion scratch. The old counter is consumed; unrelated stacks, including `X`, are preserved. Cleanup is part of the charged run.

nodes.summary: Convert a unary count to the canonical unframed Nat payload, preserving an earlier output suffix and clearing every used work stack.
nodes.title: Converter turns a unary count into a raw canonical binary payload

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
